title: Kya Rang Laayi Shaadi Ibne Hassan Tumhaari
body:
Kya rang layee shaadi ibne hasan tumhari
Raahe khuda main sheh ne aise uthaye sadme, ayoob Karbala main akar yeh haal dekhe, apni aba bicha kar sheh choon rahe hai tukde, khusboo ki tarha ran main yo teri laash bikhri, kya rang layee shaadi ibne hasan tumhari
Paighame mout aaya sar se khula na sehra, karne jehaad haq par ran ko chala tha dulha, ladta bhi kab talak wo tha teen din ka pyaasa, tera baras ke sin main uftaad hain ye kaisi, kya rang layee shaadi ibne hasan tumhari
Kis moose leke jayoon khaime main tera laasha, kubra kya bataoo jo haal hain tumhara, ujdi hain maang uski jiska khula na kangna, lamhoon ki ek dulhan bewa bani hain baithi, kya rang layee shaadi ibne hasan tumhari
<<DIVIDER>>
Gul pairahan ye tera kya haal hogaya hain, shaadi ke ghar mein yaarab ye kaisa mareka hain, dulhan ko sar se paatak sakta padha huwa hain, matam kada bana hain ab hujlaye oroosi, kya rang layee shaadi ibne hasan tumhari
Teri bahen Sakina dil main racchaye Armaan, aati hain nek lene dekho toh uski behna, dar par khadi hain akar shaadi ka leke samaan, aayegi laash aise usko khabar nahi thi, kya rang layee shaadi ibne hasan tumhari
Masnad bichaoo logo aati hain laash nousha, farwa se koi kehde aata hain uska beta, tar khoon main jo dekha phat jay na kaleja, kis kam sini main haye Qasim ko mout aayi, kya rang layee shaadi ibne hasan tumhari
Kis karb ka hain manzar chhayi hain jo udaasi, paihne libaas ghamgeen aaye hain sab barati, dekhi na phir jahaan main aisi sohail shaadi, dulha dulhan main yaraab kaisi hain ye judayi, kya rang layee shaadi ibne hasan tumhari
